_comment: TransformerPath Grid Lab. Derived from data/grids.json. Not a 3D model. Country Grid Lab is later.
note: Country Grid Lab (per-country engineering models) is scheduled later — not the next 3D model.

scenarios.title: 50 Hz and 60 Hz worlds
scenarios.summary: The census records national frequency. Most of the world is 50 Hz; a smaller set — including North America, parts of the Americas, Saudi Arabia, Japan (split), South Korea and the Philippines — is 60 Hz.
scenarios.prompt: Which of these census countries is recorded as 60 Hz?
scenarios.answer_hint: 60 Hz countries in this census include Saudi Arabia, South Korea, Taiwan, Philippines, USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil….

census_readout.label: Census readout — 60 Hz countries (simulator, not a 3D model)

scenarios.title: UHV and 765 kV class
scenarios.summary: A 765 kV class grid is uncommon. The census records transmission voltage per operator — UHV / 765 kV is a structured voltage match, not a marketing label.
scenarios.prompt: Open the directory for 765 kV manufacturers after this scenario. First: which census countries show a grid voltage of 765 kV or above?
scenarios.answer_hint: Census countries at ≥765 kV: Kazakhstan (1150 kV); South Africa (765 kV); India (765 kV); China (1000 kV); South Korea (765 kV); USA (765 kV); Venezuela (765 kV).

scenarios.title: Synchronous areas
scenarios.summary: grids.json records a free-text `sync` label (Continental Europe, GCCIA, Isolated, …). It is not yet a controlled vocabulary — Grid Lab therefore asks you to read the label, not to invent a “synchronous-area total”.
scenarios.prompt: Which of these countries is labelled GCCIA in the census?
scenarios.answer_hint: GCCIA-labelled countries: United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, Iraq.

scenarios.title: 400 kV class grids
scenarios.summary: 400 kV (and nearby 380 / 400 / 420 kV) is the common extra-high-voltage transmission class outside UHV systems.
scenarios.prompt: The census maps 151 national grids. Which of these reaches at least 400 kV but below 765 kV?

scenarios.title: Isolated systems
scenarios.summary: An Isolated sync label means the census does not record a continental synchronous tie — islands, remote systems, or unlinked national grids.
scenarios.prompt: Which of these is labelled Isolated in the census?
scenarios.answer_hint: 25 census rows carry an Isolated (or similar) sync label.

scenarios.title: Highest voltage in the census
scenarios.summary: The highest transmission voltage in this census is derived from operator voltage strings — never invented.
scenarios.prompt: What is the highest transmission voltage currently recorded in the grid census, and where?
options: A figure we do not have
scenarios.answer_hint: 🇰🇿 Kazakhstan records 1150 kV as the highest operator voltage in this census.
